Sunday Night Traditional Irish Seisiún
Sunday October 4th
Every Sunday night is our Traditional Irish Seisiún. It is one of the longest running seisiúns in NYC and is hosted by Tony DeMarco (fiddle). Other guest musicians join in as the night goes on. In the past the seisiún has been the subject of an article in the NY Times and Tony appeared on “Live From Here” with Chris Thile on NPR. Without a doubt one of the best things you can do on a Sunday Night in NYC!

Liverpool Football Club
11th St. Bar is the long-standing Official home of the New York Liverpool Supporters Club. Although LFCNY has expanded their reach with new bars, membership is still handled exclusively at the 11th St. Bar (on match days only).
The bar typically opens one hour before each game. Please check our events page for exact times. We do not accept reservations. It is first come first serve until we hit our capacity of 125.

Welcome to Area Bar!
This is a classic dive bar in the East Village of New York City. There is pinball, sports and Happy Hour until 8pm. The drinks are delicious and the tunes are on point. The Bloody Mary is spicy.
Area 140 First has the only bed of nails on permanent display on the block. The logo is a math puzzle. Our straws are made out of hay. We practice steps of service. Come and enjoy!

The Room
— Our Story
“The room was built in the language of agave: smoke, candle, tile.”
Where agave meets the
East Village.
Maya was built around a single conviction: that mezcal, in all its smoke and complexity, deserves a room as romantic as the spirit itself.
Voted one of the country's top mezcal bars by Food & Wine, we curate rare agave from small Oaxacan palenques and pair it with elevated Mexican comfort food. We build every cocktail by hand. We treat every guest like family.

lar game-day spot for fans near Central Park and Columbia University, pairing sports viewing with Latin Caribbean cuisine, craft cocktails, and daily Happy Hour specials.
What are City Coffee & Bar’s happy hour hours?
Happy hour at City Coffee & Bar runs Monday all night starting at 11:00 AM, and Tuesday through Friday from 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM. It applies to drinks and food from the dedicated Happy Hour menu and is one of the most consistent recurring deals at this Upper West Side restaurant and bar.
What weekly specials and events does City Coffee & Bar run?
City Coffee & Bar runs a full weekly lineup of nightlife events on Columbus Avenue: Happy Hour Monday–Friday (11 AM–7 PM, all night Monday); Taco Tuesday (4 PM–1 AM) with $3 tacos, $1 shots, $5 beers, and a 2-tacos-plus-margarita combo for $9.99; Ladies Night every Friday (4 PM–8 PM); the $20 Sunday Hookah Special (8 PM–close); Latin Saturdays with live DJs (9 PM–4 AM); and Bottomless Brunch every Saturday and Sunday ($19.95 for 90 minutes).
Is there live music or a DJ at City Coffee & Bar?
Yes — City Coffee & Bar features live DJs spinning reggaeton, bachata, Afrobeats, and other global hits, with Latin Saturdays (9 PM–4 AM) as the venue’s flagship DJ night. This Latin nightlife programming runs alongside hookah, handcrafted cocktails, and Caribbean-inspired bites, making it one of the Upper West Side’s few late-night destinations combining live DJs with a hookah lounge.

Life gets busy, but enjoying great food doesn’t have to be. At Noche Mexicana, we make it easy to order for pickup or have your meal delivered straight to you.
